mission: From Thailand to the World — Helping humans learn and grow.
vision: Build trustworthy, human-in-the-loop AI agent teams for LINE Official Accounts and web operations where every business keeps full ownership of its data.
principles: Non-destructive append-only learning: never erase or duplicate verified records; supersede via linked revisions.
Strict case-by-case individual learning isolation: each agent owns its own namespace and never mixes cases with another agent.
One major curated team learning ledger per team, maintained by that team's manager.
Central Command receives Founder commands, convenes Team Managers to plan and divide work, tracks manager follow-up, and requires final sign-off from Health, Security, and Audit teams.
Universal multi-LLM readability across GitHub, Supabase, Railway, LangSmith, and Notion.

github.role: Canonical source code, org roster, migrations, tests, and JSON/JSONL learning ledgers

supabase.role: Multi-tenant PostgreSQL 17, app_metadata RLS, append-only individual & team learning tables, reports, and governance audit logs

line_oa.group_policy: 1 Official Account per group; off | mention_only | keyword | always
line_oa.role: 1:1 chats, group chats, interactive Flex Cards, Quick Replies, and channel-routed reports

langsmith.role: Optional non-blocking PII-free trace export for workflow runs, learning updates, and evaluations

notion.role: Human & multi-LLM readable executive hub for org chart, requirements, checklist, and synced learning lessons

workflow_protocol: 1. Founder submits task or command to Central Command.
2. Central Command convenes relevant Team Managers to discuss constraints, dependencies, and risks.
3. Central Command divides work into bounded, non-overlapping team assignments with acceptance checks.
4. Specialist agents execute inside their scope and append case-by-case learnings to their isolated individual namespace.
5. Each Team Manager verifies accuracy, curates verified patterns into the team's major learning ledger, and reports completion.
6. Final 3 Governance Teams (Health, Security, Audit) inspect runtime health, RLS/privacy/secrets, and append-only rule compliance before sign-off and channel report dispatch.

teams.name: AI Engineering & Architecture Team (FE + BE)
teams.mission: Architect frontend & backend data structures, zero-error service guardrails, deterministic tests, and structured error-to-fix learning patterns.

teams.name: Customer Service Team (Frontline)
teams.mission: Serve active customer inquiries, grounded price quotes, order status, and lead times with seamless human handover.

teams.name: After-Service & Care Team (Separate Role)
teams.mission: Handle post-delivery warranty claims, damage/defect resolution, satisfaction follow-ups, and retention care strictly separated from frontline sales/CS.

teams.mission: Qualify B2B leads, prepare grounded quotation briefs, craft brand proposals and campaigns, and route discount approvals to humans.

teams.name: Final Governance Team 1 — Health & Reliability
teams.mission: Monitor live uptime (/ready, /version), <2.5s Race SLA, provider circuit breakers, and cross-platform connector health.

teams.name: Final Governance Team 2 — Security & Privacy
teams.mission: Verify app_metadata RLS isolation, zero PII/secret/code leaks, path traversal guards, Flex URI allowlists, and fail-closed error handling.

teams.name: Final Governance Team 3 — Audit & Command Compliance
teams.mission: Audit all teams for zero duplication, zero erasure, isolated individual vs team learning integrity, and strict execution under Founder prompts and rules.
